Huafeng Technology.why: Makes high-speed backplane connectors and high-speed cable modules for AI servers and data centers (112G in volume production, 224G in mass production since June 2026), so AI-server build-out drives its main growth.
Huafeng Technology.evidence: Huafeng Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026): AI-server and data-center demand drove revenue growth, with core products such as high-speed cable modules raising their penetration in leading server equipment; 112G products in stable volume production and delivery, entering the supply chain of mainstream computing equipment.

players.product: 112G / 224G high-speed backplane cable modules and backplane connectors, CPU sockets for AI servers

quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (annual report): revenue RMB 2,527,729,770.66, up 131.50%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 358,571,551.61 (2024: a loss of RMB 17,750,544.81); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 330,517,190.78. Quarterly revenue Q1-Q4 2025: RMB 405,525,885.18, RMB 699,363,145.47, RMB 554,285,509.45, RMB 868,555,230.56. Company: growth came from data-center infrastructure upgrades, the AI-compute demand boom and rising new-energy-vehicle penetration; data-center build-out lifted demand for switches, accelerated-computing servers and core routers and with it the company's connection products.

quarterly_data.quarter: Huafeng Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): in communications the company will deepen cooperation with existing strategic partners while focusing on breaking into the data-center and computing-infrastructure markets of internet technology giants and global mainstream cloud providers, offering full-series connection solutions that meet open standards, to reduce dependence on a single market; it also plans global patent filings and localized technical support centers, scale application of high-speed and high-voltage new-energy-vehicle connectors, and connector standards work in the low-altitude economy.
